title: pouteria lucuma

This tree is native to the Andean region and is valued for its edible fruit, which has a rich, sweet flavor. The lucuma fruit has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The bioactive constituents of Pouteria lucuma include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and anticancer properties.
